newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - BHP sees local steel market improving.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - BHP sees local steel market improving.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Friday that despite a flat Australian market for steel during the three months August 31 there were signs of improvement in domestic demand in structural, reinforcing and flat products.

The troubled steel unit's net profit for the first quarter was A$90 million, falling from A$146 million a year ago on lower export prices and lower Australian domestic despatches for the Flat Products and Long Products divisions.
"I think we can continue to lift steel's performance," BHP managing director John Prescott said in a pre-recorded interview.

The lower results from two divisions were partly offset by higher profits from the building and industrial products division which incorporates the Tubemakers business purchased via a mop-up bid earlier this year.

Raw Steel production in Australia and New Zealand of 2.159 million tonnes was in line with last year while steel despathces from all operations were 2.018 million tonnes, up seven percent compared with the year earlier period.
At 0340 GMT (1.40 p.m.), BHP shares were down three cents to A$16.06.
